engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a small e-commerce store selling everyday items (totes, bottles, lamps, etc.) with a product catalogue, shopping cart, order history, user accounts, and an admin login.

demo_journeys.name: Browse & Add to Cart
steps: Open the shop page and scan the product grid
Use the sort dropdown (Price: low to high) or the search box to find a product
Click into the Canvas Tote product page (/product/1) and read the description
Click 'Add to cart' on the product page
Navigate to /cart and confirm the item appears with its price

demo_journeys.name: Login & Account Settings
steps: Go to /login and enter the demo email and password
Click 'Log in' and confirm you are redirected back to the shop as 'Bob Tester'
Navigate to /account, change the display name field, and click Save

demo_journeys.name: Order History & Delete
steps: From the top nav, click Orders to land on /orders
Review the existing order #1000 (1 item, $45.00)
Click Delete on the order row and confirm the row is removed

demo_journeys.name: Register a New Account
steps: Go to /register and fill in Name, Email, and Password (8+ chars)
Click 'Create account' and verify the success message or redirect
Use the new credentials on /login to confirm the account works
